outcome: Mode of delivery (caesarean section vs. vaginal delivery)
cohort: The study included 7,327 physicians matched 1:5 to 36,185 non-physicians, all residing in high-income urban areas of Ontario, Canada, with pregnancies occurring between April 2009 and November 2018.
finding: Physicians and non-physicians had a comparable rate of C-section, but non-physicians experienced a higher risk of maternal urgent postpartum care.
mod_finding: Physicians and non-physicians had a similar risk of C-section.
